stories.head: AlphaGenome 2 conditions DNA predictions on cell state
stories.fact: AlphaGenome 2 takes a DNA sequence and a target tissue, cell type or state to predict variant effects. DeepMind announced non-commercial research API access and a private preview for commercial research.
stories.why: For MATLAB research, compare explicitly conditioned models with pooled models under held-out regimes; treat this as an architectural analogy.
stories.unc: Biological results do not establish financial forecasting value; reported performance comes from the developer.
stories.alt: Conceptual labels connect DNA and cell-state inputs to variant-effect predictions and mark financial transfer as an untested analogy.

stories.head: Order-flow model forecasts moves smaller than trading costs
stories.fact: Shabashev pretrains a 300-million-parameter model on Level-3 data from Bitstamp and Bitfinex, then fine-tunes microprice-return and realized-volatility forecasts. The paper reports sub-second predictive gains, but forecast moves are smaller than spread plus fees.
stories.why: Evaluate execution or market-making decisions against latency and fill-aware baselines; forecast accuracy alone is not tradable alpha.
stories.unc: Crypto-exchange evidence does not establish equity transfer, live profitability or feasibility with daily OHLCV data.
stories.alt: Conceptual labels show pretraining, forecast fine-tuning and the paper’s explicit spread-plus-fees limitation.

stories.head: Nasdaq futures retreat while Dow contracts edge higher
stories.fact: At 5:32 a.m. EST, Reuters reported Nasdaq 100 futures down 0.64%, S&P 500 futures down 0.31%, and Dow futures up 0.12%.
stories.why: Monitor QQQ/SPY divergence and technology concentration; refresh spreads and depth before assuming yesterday’s rally continues.
stories.unc: Earlier reported snapshot, not executable quotes. Price direction does not measure liquidity.
stories.alt: Three labels show Nasdaq and S&P futures lower and Dow futures higher at the same November 12 checkpoint.

stories.head: Waller puts a larger December rate increase on the table
stories.fact: Before the October CPI release, Governor Waller said he leaned toward a 25-basis-point December increase, but a 50-basis-point increase should be considered if core CPI remained around 0.3% monthly or higher.
stories.why: Stress both rate paths and distinguish an individual official’s conditional guidance from an FOMC decision.
stories.unc: The speech preceded CPI; it is not a post-release commitment, consensus forecast or announced policy change.
stories.alt: Labels separate Waller’s baseline preference from a conditional larger increase and explicitly date the speech before CPI.

stories.head: IBM outlines Nighthawk r3 and a larger quantum system
stories.fact: IBM announced Nighthawk r3, designed for 10,000 quantum operations on 520 programmable qubits, and plans to link two r3 processors in 2027 into a system exceeding 1,000 qubits.
stories.why: Evaluate accuracy, end-to-end runtime and classical comparison costs before assigning business value to larger quantum hardware.
stories.unc: These r3 specifications and the linked system are roadmap targets, not a verified deployed capability or proof of financial advantage.
stories.alt: Roadmap labels identify planned r3 operations, programmable qubits and a 2027 linked system, explicitly distinguishing targets from deployed advantage.
